items.title: Choose your split
items.body: Under your goal, pick how the week alternates: full body, upper / lower, push pull legs, body part, Arnold and more. Or let your goal decide.

items.title: Set each day's focus
items.body: Tap a day in Your week to make it chest & triceps, back & biceps, legs, glutes or any other session. It stays on that day.

items.title: Focus muscles
items.body: Pick the muscles you want to grow faster. They get an extra set and come right after the main lift.
